subject: AEPH
title: Elements of Physics
description: A conceptual survey of topics in physics relevant to the study of agricultural and environmental sciences: Newtonian mechanics, celestial motion, oscillations and waves, sound, electricity and magnetism, and light.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken or are taking AEPH 113 and AEPH 115, or equivalent combination.

subject: AEPH
title: Introductory Physics 1
description: Kinematics in one and two dimensions. Newton's laws of motion. Circular motion and orbits. Rotation of a rigid body. Momentum. Work and energy, power. Conservation principles. Simple harmonic motion. Waves and sound.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have passed AEPH 113 or obtained CEGEP competency 00UR. Not open to students in Bioresource Engineering.

notes: Three 1-hour lectures, one 2-hour lab, one 1.5-hour tutorial per week

subject: AEPH
title: Physics 1
description: Kinematics in one and two dimensions. Newton's laws of motion. Circular motion and orbits. Rotation of a rigid body. Momentum. Work and energy, power. Conservation principles. Simple harmonic motion. Waves and sound. Includes calculus-based applications.

restrictions.text: Note: Not open to students who have taken AEPH 112, PHYS 101 or PHYS 131, and open to students in Bioresource Engineering; Not open to students who have passed AEPH 112 or obtained CEGEP competency 00UR. Open only to students in Bioresource Engineering.

notes: Three 1-hour lectures, one 2-hour lab, and one 1-hour tutorial per week.

subject: AEPH
title: Introductory Physics 2
description: Electric and magnetic properties of matter: electrostatics, electric currents, the link between electric and magnetic phenomena, geometrical optics, interference diffraction.

prerequisites.text: AEPH 112 or AEPH 113 or PHYS 101 or PHYS 131 or CEGEP objective 00UR or equivalents, or permission of instructor

corequisites.text: AEMA 102 (or MATH 141 or higher level calculus course) or CEGEP objective 00UP, or permission of instructor.

restrictions.text: Not open to students who have taken PHYS 102 or PHYS 142 or AEPH 115 or CEGEP objective 00US or equivalent. Not open to students in Bioresource Engineering.

notes: 3 lecture hours, 2 lab hours, 2 tutorial hours

subject: AEPH
title: Physics 2
description: Electric forces, electric fields, electric potential. Current. Electric circuits. Magnetic fields and forces. Electromagnetic induction. Electromagnetic waves. Geometrical and physical optics. Includes calculus-based applications.

prerequisites.text: AEPH 112 or AEPH 113 or PHYS 101or PHYS 131 or equivalent.

restrictions.text: Note: Not open to students who have taken AEPH 114, PHYS 102 or PHYS 142, and open only to students in Bioresource Engineering; Not open to students who have passed AEPH 114 or obtained CEGEP competencies 00US and 00UT. Open only to students in Bioresource Engineering.

notes: Three 1-hour lectures, one 2-hour lab, and one 1-hour tutorial per week

subject: AEPH
title: Physics Laboratory 1
description: The laboratory component of AEPH 112/AEPH 113. Illustrative experiments.

restrictions.text: Open only to entering students who have the lecture equivalent of AEPH 112 or AEPH 113. Not open to students who have taken or are taking AEPH 112, AEPH 113, PHYS 101, PHYS 107, PHYS 117, PHYS 131.
